query:
SELECT p.id, p.name,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN m.family IN ('Norisoprénoïde','norisoprenoide','norisoprenoid') THEN 1 END) as noris,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN m.family IN ('Phénol','phenol') OR m.name IN ('Catéchol','Crésol','Syringol') THEN 1 END) as phenols
FROM plants p
LEFT JOIN plant_molecules pm ON pm.plant_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN molecules m ON m.id = pm.molecule_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Nicotiana%' OR p.name LIKE '%Virginia%' OR p.name LIKE '%Burley%' OR p.name LIKE '%Latakia%' OR p.name LIKE '%Samsun%' OR p.name LIKE '%Caporal%'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY p.name;
